tooltip.just_a_rifle.winchester.subtitle: Lever-Action Repeater · .44-40 WCF
tooltip.just_a_rifle.cartridge.usage: Press [%s] with Winchester 1873 to load · 1.5× Headshot
config.just_a_rifle.audio.master.tooltip: Master gain (0–200%) applied to all Winchester 1873 sounds on your client.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.fire.tooltip: Volume of the primary black-powder rifle report (both yours and nearby players').
config.just_a_rifle.audio.bass_thump.too: Intensity of the low-end physical chest thump layered beneath each shot.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.fire_tone.tool: Shapes the acoustic character of gunfire: Balanced original, deeper Frontier boom, or sharper Crack.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.mechanism.tool: Volume of mechanical lever cycling, hammer cocking, and submerged wet misfires.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.reload.tooltip: Volume of opening the King's loading gate, inserting .44-40 rounds, and closing the action.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.handling.toolt: Volume of drawing the rifle, stowing it on the back sling [F], and inspecting [I].
config.just_a_rifle.audio.casings.toolti: Volume of spent .44-40 brass shells clinking on floors and settling underwater.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.impacts.toolti: Volume of bullet impacts and ricochets across stone, metal, wood, glass, earth, and crystal.
config.just_a_rifle.audio.feedback.toolt: Dedicated volume for acoustic feedback: entity hit/headshot confirmation, Target block chimes, and empty clicks.
config.just_a_rifle.feedback.hit_sound.t: Selects the private confirmation cue played when your bullet strikes a mob or player (harmonic double-cue on headshots).
config.just_a_rifle.feedback.target_chim: Controls when the musical chime plays upon hitting a Redstone Target block.
config.just_a_rifle.feedback.dry_click.t: Plays a crisp metallic dry-click alert when pulling the trigger or reloading without ammo.
config.just_a_rifle.controls.ads_mode.to: Hold aims while right-click stays pressed; Toggle latches/releases iron sights on each right-click.
config.just_a_rifle.controls.auto_reload: Automatically starts reloading when attempting to fire an empty magazine tube (0 / 8).
config.just_a_rifle.controls.ads_sensiti: Mouse turn speed multiplier while aiming down the iron sights (20–150%).
config.just_a_rifle.camera.ads_zoom.tool: FOV zoom strength in ADS: 0% disables zoom, 100% default (1.5x), 150% sharpshooter zoom.
config.just_a_rifle.camera.recoil_kick.t: Camera climb and micro-shake per shot (0% removes screen shake while keeping 3D rifle recoil).
config.just_a_rifle.camera.weapon_sway.t: Intensity of idle breathing motion and walking bob on the 1st-person rifle.
config.just_a_rifle.hud.ammo_position.to: Selects where the (8 / 8) magazine counter is anchored on screen, or hides it completely.
config.just_a_rifle.hud.show_reserve.too: Displays your total inventory .44-40 cartridges with a mini brass icon next to 8 / 8 (shows ∞ in Creative).
config.just_a_rifle.hud.accent_color.too: Custom RGB accent for the ammo counter border, hotbar ammo bar, and hitmarker.
config.just_a_rifle.hud.ads_vignette.too: Subtle peripheral screen framing while aiming down sights (0% disables completely).
config.just_a_rifle.hud.hide_crosshair_a: Hides Vanilla's '+' crosshair while aiming so the Winchester iron sights stay unobstructed.
config.just_a_rifle.hud.hitmarker.toolti: Draws a crisp center '×' tick on entity hits (and a crimson-gold double tick on 1.5× headshots).
config.just_a_rifle.hud.rich_tooltips.to: Shows loaded rounds, reserve ammo, headshot/falloff ballistics, and live remapped keybinds on rifle & cartridge tooltips.
config.just_a_rifle.world.max_casings.to: Maximum simultaneous 3D .44-40 brass shells in the world (0 disables casing ejection).
config.just_a_rifle.world.casing_lifetim: Seconds each spent brass casing remains on the ground before fading out.
config.just_a_rifle.world.max_bullet_hol: Maximum simultaneous bullet impact decals on blocks (0 disables bullet holes).
config.just_a_rifle.world.bullet_hole_li: Seconds bullet impact decals remain on surfaces before fading out.
config.just_a_rifle.world.back_sling.too: Controls how your off-hand Winchester [F] is worn across your character's back.
